description: defp f(%{} = m) fails: internal/post-resolution-leftover: quoted function decode failed: pattern as-bind lhs must be a variable (src/compiler2/quoted_function.rs:540). Elixir accepts the match in either order (m = %{} and %{} = m mean the same in a pattern). tools/distill-telemetry.exs:76 writes defp label(%{} = meta, _names) when map_size(meta) == 0. Probe in scratch kernel/.
